name: Arcturus Defense Solutions Ballistic Helmet BH-9 'Ironhead'
product_name: Arcturus Defense Solutions Ballistic Helmet BH-9 'Ironhead'
description: A full-coverage tactical helmet with integrated comms, HUD visor, NBC filter, and NIJ Level IV ballistic protection. The BH-9 uses a composite of boron carbide ceramic and ultra-high-molecular-weight polyethylene to defeat rifle-caliber threats while remaining under 2 kg. The integrated visor provides thermal, low-light, and AR overlay modes, and the helmet's padded interior includes impact-absorbing gel that reduces concussive force transmission by 80%. It has become the standard-issue helmet for corporate security forces across GLMZ.
story_hooks: A BH-9's HUD recorded the wearer's final moments during an ambush — the footage has become evidence in a corporate liability case.
Modified BH-9 helmets with removed IFF transponders are being sold to non-aligned combatants who want the protection without the corporate tracking.
